extensions.source: Recorded from the shipped build on branch split-flap-redesign (9ac0d5f). Ground values come from the user-chosen first-viewport sketch (splitflap.html, the TV lobby) as built in src/styles.css :root.

display.purpose: Winner's name, hub title, the six-cell room code. Big moments are big flaps.

flap.purpose: Every flap cell; sized in em by its context. Barlow Condensed 600, uppercase.

headline.purpose: A clue or question on the TV, set type, balanced, max 26ch.

body.purpose: Instructions, how-to-play, hints and notes in Barlow Semi Condensed.

input.purpose: Text the host or a player types.

label.purpose: Board legends beside a datum, departure-row column heads, field labels. Steel, tracked capitals.

key.purpose: Main actions, phone keys and the buzzer.

shadows.name: board-edge
shadows.purpose: Every screen root, seating the board in the steel frame.

shadows.name: module-ring
shadows.purpose: A steel band around flap modules such as the Jeoparty board.

shadows.name: flap-underside
shadows.purpose: The bottom edge of each flap cell.

shadows.name: key-lip
shadows.purpose: Underside lip of the main action; press drops 1px.

shadows.name: buzzer
shadows.purpose: The phone's big square key in its well and steel ring.

shadows.name: lit-outline
shadows.purpose: Winner's row, team in control, hovered Jeoparty cell.

shadows.name: team-edge
shadows.purpose: A team's or contestant's quiet colour along the top of its panel or podium.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: A small board in its own steel frame; the only use of --shadow.

motion.name: flap-hop
motion.purpose: How long each intermediate drum character stays up.

motion.name: flap-stagger
motion.purpose: Delay between a changed cell and the next changed cell to its right.

motion.name: flap-drum
motion.purpose: Drum characters a changed cell runs through before it lands; unchanged cells hold still.

motion.name: flap-fall
motion.value: 70ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.7, 1), rotateX(-84deg) and brightness(1.6) to rest
motion.purpose: Each new character falling from the hinge.

motion.name: flap-strip
motion.purpose: A whole-word strip flap turning over once.

motion.name: flap-reduced
motion.purpose: Reduced motion: the whole change fades in once, no cascade.

motion.name: clack
motion.purpose: Synthesized clack per flipping step, TV only, through the TV's mute; phones and setup are silent.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Background, border and colour changes on buttons, cells and rows.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Rows joining a list (Final Jeoparty reveals, Fast Money results) and dialogs.

motion.name: signal-flash
motion.purpose: The phone's ground warms to the lamp on a right call, or to red on a wrong one.

lampTable.purpose: Each game re-sets --table / --on-table on its root (styles.css, Tables block). Components read var(--table) only.

teams.note: Never red; always paired with a number cell and name. Tip of the Tongue uses a steel-hi number cell.

components.name: Flap Cells
components.description: The signature: one matte two-half cell per character with a dark hairline, used for every datum.
components.html: K7Q2MX
components.css: .ds-flap { display: inline-flex; gap: 0.08em; font-size: 64px; padding: 16px; background: #16171a; } .ds-flap-c { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 0.74em; height: 1.18em; border-radius: 0.06em; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #222327 0 50%, #1d1e21 50% 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 -0.02em 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6); color: #f2f2ee; font: 600 1em/1 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; overflow: hidden; } .ds-flap-c::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: calc(50% - 0.018em); height: 0.036em; background: #0b0b0d; } .ds-flap-c:hover { color: #e8a23a; }

components.name: Primary (the one lit cell)
components.description: The screen's one main action, lit in the game's lamp.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 50px; padding: 0 30px; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; background: #e8a23a; color: #1a1205; font: 700 1.05rem/1 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.22); cursor: pointer; transition: filter 160ms ease-out, transform 90ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.07); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f2f2ee; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Primary, not yet
components.description: A dark cell with dim letters, so 'not yet' never reads as a faded 'yes'.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary-off { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 50px; padding: 0 30px; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; background: #222327; color: #6b6e75; font: 700 1.05rem/1 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #45484e; }

components.name: Secondary
components.description: A steel-outlined cell for second actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px solid #5b5e63; background: transparent; color: #f2f2ee; font: 600 1rem/1 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #222327; border-color: #8b8f96; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f2f2ee; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Choice Cells
components.description: Setup options: a square row marker, hollow when off, filled in the lamp when on.
components.css: .ds-choices { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-choice { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 42px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 3px; background: #222327; border: 1px solid transparent; color: #a7aaaf; font: 600 0.98rem/1 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, color 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-choice::before { content: ''; width: 9px; height: 9px; border: 2px solid currentColor; } .ds-choice:hover { color: #f2f2ee; border-color: #45484e; } .ds-choice[aria-checked='true'] { color: #e8a23a; border-color: #e8a23a; background: color-mix(in srgb, #e8a23a 9%, #222327); } .ds-choice[aria-checked='true']::before { background: currentColor; } .ds-choice:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f2f2ee; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: A recessed well with a lamp-coloured focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; } .ds-field span { font: 600 0.82rem/1.2 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8b8f96; } .ds-field input { min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid #45484e; border-radius: 3px; background: #0e0f11; color: #f2f2ee; caret-color: #e8a23a; font: 500 1.06rem/1.3 'Barlow Semi Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; transition: border-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #8a8d94; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #e8a23a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #e8a23a; }

components.name: Departure Row
components.description: A lobby player or hub game as a board row: name, team, status cell with a marker.
components.css: .ds-dep { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 12px; display: grid; gap: 6px; background: #16171a; } .ds-dep li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 0.6fr; gap: 4px; min-height: 52px; } .ds-dep li > span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0.1em 14px 0; background: #0e0f11; color: #f2f2ee; font: 600 1.6rem/1 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-dep .ds-dep-status { color: #e8a23a; } .ds-dep .ds-dep-status::before { content: ''; width: 0.36em; height: 0.36em; background: #e8a23a; } .ds-dep li.is-open > span { color: #6b6e75; } .ds-dep li.is-open .ds-dep-status::before { background: transparent; border: 2px solid #6b6e75; } .ds-dep li:hover > span:first-child { color: #e8a23a; }

components.name: Buzzer
components.description: The ticket machine's big square key: dark until live, lamp-lit when ready.
components.css: .ds-buzzer { width: 220px; aspect-ratio: 1; margin: 16px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 6px; background: #222327; color: #6b6e75; border: 1px solid #45484e; font: 700 2.4rem/1 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px #0e0f11, 0 0 0 10px #5b5e63, inset 0 -6px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, transform 80ms ease-out, box-shadow 80ms ease-out; } .ds-buzzer.is-ready { background: #e8a23a; color: #1a1205; border-color: transparent; } .ds-buzzer.is-ready:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px #0e0f11, 0 0 0 10px #5b5e63, inset 0 -2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35); } .ds-buzzer:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f2f2ee; outline-offset: 14px; }

components.name: Jeoparty Board Cell
components.description: The Jeoparty board as a flap module: show-blue halves, gold value, steel ring.
components.css: .ds-jb { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 120px); gap: 6px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 3px; background: #0b0b0d; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #000, 0 0 0 5px #2a2d31; } .ds-jb-cell { min-height: 72px; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1b2a7a 0 50%, #172468 50% 100%); color: #e2b54a; font: 600 1.8rem/1 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 160ms ease-out; } .ds-jb-cell:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #e2b54a; } .ds-jb-cell.is-used { background: #0f1641; cursor: default; } .ds-jb-cell:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f2f2ee; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Strike Cells
components.description: Red only for strikes: X marks on flap-face cells, the lit strike ringed in red.
components.css: .ds-strikes { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-strikes span { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 2px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #222327 0 50%, #1d1e21 50% 100%); color: #45484e; } .ds-strikes .is-on { color: #c6463c; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #c6463c; }

narrative.overview:
Every screen in Game Night is one matte split-flap board in a brushed steel frame, the departure board of a quiet station concourse at night. The shared screen is the board itself: codes, scores, clocks, categories, answers, titles and winners are set on flap cells that clack over, left to right, when they change. Phones are the ticket machine beside it: a small board on top carrying your score, and one big key at a time below. The ground values were taken from the user-chosen first-viewport sketch (`splitflap.html`, the TV lobby) and that is what shipped: a dark charcoal board rather than pure black, with lighter flap faces sitting on it.

The board is quiet so the data can be loud. There is no glow, no chrome bevel, no bolts, no gradients beyond the flap's two halves and the frame's brushed steel. Each game keeps exactly one lamp colour, the way a real board has one row-lamp colour; the house lamp is amber. Big moments are big because flaps get big (the six-cell room code, the winner's name), not because anything shines. Red is held back for strikes, fouls and fails only.

The system rejects the pinball cabinet it replaced (chrome lettering, sunburst rays, dot-matrix numbers, neon lamps and glows) and the category default of rounded party cards on purple.
keyCharacteristics: One charcoal board (#16171a) inside a brushed steel frame on every screen.
Data rides on split-flap cells; instructions and prose are set type, never flaps.
One quiet lamp colour per game, set as `--table` on the game's root; red only for strikes, fouls and fails.
State is row state: dim letters, white letters, lamp-coloured status plus a filled marker; never colour alone.
Barlow Condensed for flaps and labels, Barlow Semi Condensed for prose, both self-hosted.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: A game has one lamp colour, set once as `--table` on its root. Everything lit on that game's screens uses `var(--table)`; a second accent is a defect.

rules.name: The Red Is Bad News Rule
rules.body: Red appears only for strikes, fouls, fails and destructive actions. Teams, contestants and lamps are never red.

rules.name: The Charcoal Not Black Rule
rules.body: The board is `board` charcoal and flap faces are lighter than the board. `flap-gap` black is reserved for hairlines, edges and gaps; it is never the fill of a cell.

rules.name: The Flaps Carry Data Rule
rules.body: Codes, scores, clocks, answers, titles and names-in-lights go on flap cells. Instructions, prose and clue text are set type, never flaps.

rules.name: The Tracked Capitals Rule
rules.body: Barlow Condensed is always uppercase; tracking widens as size drops (0 on flaps, 0.02 to 0.06em on headings and row names, 0.1 to 0.24em on labels and keys). Barlow Semi Condensed stays in sentence case.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: Lamps are flat fills. No outer glow, no blur halo, no neon text-shadow. The only brightness change is the momentary flash on a falling flap (`brightness(1.6)` at the start of the fall).

dos: Do set every screen on the `board` charcoal inside the steel frame, with flap faces lighter than the board.
Do put data on flap cells and prose in Barlow Semi Condensed set type.
Do read the lamp through `var(--table)` / `var(--on-table)` and set each game's pair once on its root.
Do carry every state with a second cue: filled versus hollow markers, dim versus white letters, number cells for teams, X cells and strike counts for misses.
Do flip only the cells that change, and collapse the cascade to one 240ms crossfade under reduced motion.
Do keep the clack on the TV only, behind the TV's mute.
donts: Don't use `flap-gap` (#0b0b0d) as a cell fill; it is the hairline, edge and gap colour.
Don't use red for anything but strikes, fouls, fails and destructive actions; never for a team, contestant or lamp.
Don't add glow, chrome lettering, sunburst rays, dot-matrix numbers or neon lamps (the pinball cabinet this replaced).
Don't use rounded party cards on purple.
Don't give a game a second accent alongside its lamp.
Don't set instructions or paragraphs on flaps.
